prompt: Implement split_bill(total_cents, weights) in solution.py. Split total_cents among parties in proportion to the integer weights. Return a list of integer cents, one per weight, that sums exactly to total_cents. Use the largest remainder method. Give each party the floor of its exact share, then hand out the leftover cents one at a time to the parties with the largest fractional remainder, breaking ties by lower index. Run python -m pytest -q test_visible.py.

+def split_bill(total_cents: int, weights: list[int]) -> list[int]:
+    if not weights:
+        return []
+
+    sum_weights = sum(weights)
+
+    # Calculate each party's exact share
+    exact_shares = [total_cents * w / sum_weights for w in weights]
+
+    # Floor each share
+    floors = [int(s) for s in exact_shares]
+
+    # Calculate fractional remainders
+    remainders = [exact_shares[i] - floors[i] for i in range(len(weights))]
+
+    # Calculate leftover cents to distribute
+    leftover = total_cents - sum(floors)
+
+    # Sort parties by remainder (descending), breaking ties by index (ascending)
+    indices = list(range(len(weights)))
+    indices.sort(key=lambda i: (-remainders[i], i))
+
+    # Distribute leftover cents to parties with largest remainders
+    for i in range(leftover):
+        floors[indices[i]] += 1
+
+    return floors
